item.title: Wildfires in Ontario make Toronto air quality worst in world
item.description:
Devastating Consequences of Wildfires in Ontario: A Global Air Quality Crisis

The skies above Toronto have turned a sickly yellow, a stark reminder of the devastating consequences of wildfires in Ontario. Environment Canada has issued health warnings as the city’s air quality has plummeted to the worst in the world, according to IQAir, a Swiss technology company that tracks global air quality. The situation is dire, with over 100 active wildfires in northern Ontario spewing smoke that has engulfed the city and neighboring areas.
